cta.text: ASK PFEC ABOUT THE ACT MATRIX

caption_txt.title: ACT's New Canberra Matrix Portal Goes Live on 27 July — Here's What Changes
body: From 27 July, the ACT is launching its new Canberra Matrix portal — and if you're planning an ACT state nomination for a 190 or 491 visa, the way your Matrix works is changing.

The new portal lets you update your Canberra Matrix as your circumstances change, a new nomination application fee will apply, and — importantly — when two candidates have the same score, ranking will be based on your most recent update rather than your original submission date.
bullets: The new ACT Canberra Matrix portal goes live on 27 July
You'll be able to update your Matrix as your circumstances change
A new nomination application fee will apply
Same-score candidates are now ranked by their latest update, not their first submission date
caption_txt.urgency: If you're in the ACT Matrix pool, review your score and timing before 27 July so the new ranking rules work in your favour.
